name: @deepseek-ai/dsh-client-web-react
description: Dev-time type + minimal-runtime stand-in for the dsh-advisor plugin repo. The real package is private (not on the npm registry) and ships from the host dsh app at runtime; this stub provides the consumed React-binding surface (bindSnapshotSelector over a bare HostObservable, and the SnapshotSelectorHook re-export). The stand-in reads the current snapshot at call time instead of subscribing through uSES — dev-time tests drive stores directly. Mirrors dsh-private commit b8343cb (2026-08-09 snapshot).
